findings.title: Invalid ERB syntax `<%- end if %>` causes a SyntaxError when rendering `embed/best`
findings.body: Line 6 closes the `if @topic_view.posts.present?` block with `<%- end if %>`. In Ruby, `end if` without a trailing condition is invalid syntax (`SyntaxError: unexpected ';'`), so rendering the `embed/best` template will crash at runtime. (The controller spec passes only because RSpec controller specs stub view rendering by default.) This should be `<%- end %>`.

findings.title: `TopicEmbed.import_remote` calls `open(url)` without requiring `open-uri` or validating the URL scheme first
findings.body: `TopicEmbed.import_remote` calls `open(url).read` on line 48 without `require 'open-uri'` in `app/models/topic_embed.rb` and before `TopicEmbed.import` checks `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` on line 11. If `open-uri` has not been loaded by another class (such as `Jobs::PollFeed`), `Kernel#open` treats `url` as a local file path and raises `Errno::ENOENT`. Worse, because `Kernel#open` is invoked before the `^https?://` check, passing a non-HTTP string (such as a local path or a `|...` pipe command via callers like `import_remote`) allows arbitrary file reads or command execution. `open-uri` should be explicitly required and the `http`/`https` scheme validation should happen before `open(url)`.

findings.title: `i.content.scrub` raises `NoMethodError` on RSS 2.0 feeds where `i.content` is `nil`
findings.body: In `SimpleRSS`, standard RSS 2.0 `<item>` elements populate `i.description` (or `i.content_encoded`) rather than `i.content` (which is only populated for `<content>` tags such as in Atom feeds). For RSS 2.0 feeds without `<content>` elements, `i.content` is `nil`, so `i.content.scrub` raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'scrub' for nil:NilClass` and aborts the job. Additionally, `String#scrub` was only introduced in Ruby 2.1 and will raise `NoMethodError` on Ruby 2.0.

findings.title: `absolutize_urls` corrupts protocol-relative URLs starting with `//`
findings.body: In `TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls` (lines 64-65 and 70-71), any `href` or `src` where `start_with?('/')` is true has leading slashes stripped via `sub(/^\/+/, '')` and `#{prefix}/` prepended. Because protocol-relative URLs (e.g., `//cdn.example.com/image.jpg`) also start with `/`, they are rewritten into `http://<embed-host>/cdn.example.com/image.jpg`, breaking external links and images that use protocol-relative URLs.

findings.title: `TopicEmbed.import` raises `NoMethodError` when updating an embed whose post was deleted
findings.body: When a `TopicEmbed` record already exists for `url`, line 32 fetches `post = embed.post`. Because `Post` uses `Trashable` soft deletion, `embed.post` returns `nil` if the post has been deleted. If the remote content later changes (`content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1`), `PostRevisor.new(post).revise!(...)` is called with `post = nil` and crashes with `NoMethodError: undefined method 'raw' for nil:NilClass`.

findings.title: Origin check `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` allows partial/substring origin matches
findings.body: In `postMessageReceived`, `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` only checks that `e.origin` appears somewhere inside `discourseUrl`. Because `discourseUrl` includes a trailing slash or path (e.g., `http://discourse.example.com/`), any origin that is a prefix substring of the hostname (such as `http://discourse.example` or `http://discourse.example.co`) will pass `indexOf !== -1` at index 0. The check should compare parsed origins or verify `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin + '/') === 0`.
